name: Bankroll_Network
fix_description: In buyFor(), change transferFrom(_customerAddress, ...) to transferFrom(msg.sender, ...), or add require(_customerAddress == msg.sender). Currently anyone can call buyFor with an arbitrary _customerAddress and spend tokens from addresses that have approved the contract.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is very short and mechanically simple: take a flash loan, buy into the vulnerable contract, repeatedly call the same function in a loop to inflate/divert value, then sell and withdraw. Although it uses a flash loan and a protocol-specific buyFor misuse, the attack path is straightforward and a competent auditor could likely reproduce it quickly once the faulty accounting is identified.
